verdict.rationale: Poke documents a programmatic API for sending messages, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, no OpenAPI or equivalent spec is documented, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt file is LLM-oriented site documentation, not a machine-readable API specification, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
